description: The file defines the MediaEngineRMF class, a plugin for a media engine that implements plugin interfaces, manages media player states, and handles video rectangle configurations. It declares methods for playback control, volume, and initialization routines, along with event handling.

classes.name: MediaEngineRMF
classes.description: A plugin class implementing media playback control, event handling, and state management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

methods.name: initialize_player
methods.description: Initializes the media player with provided parameters and updates response accordingly.

methods.name: deinitialize_player
methods.description: Deinitializes the media player, freeing resources and updating response.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback based on given parameters.

methods.name: mute
methods.description: Sets mute state for the player.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Adjusts the volume level of the media player.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the rectangle dimensions for video display.
